neighbours.label: Words for something at an early stage with its future ahead: youth and offspring (boy, cubs, newborn), candidates (hopefuls), and the coming period (next year); low confidence that these form one feature
fire: The mayor and several other hopefuls spoke at the rally.
Two newborn cubs were found in the den this spring.
The show returns to the air early next season.
The queen soon gave birth to a healthy baby boy.
Young foxes leave their mother for the first time in autumn.
Election hopeful Smith promised lower taxes.
We hope to launch the store next year.
Their youngest son grew into a strong youth.
quiet: The mayor and several other officers spoke at the rally.
